visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a vibrant Thai green papaya salad on a white plate, featuring shredded papaya, cherry tomatoes, and long beans. A pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a bundle of the salad toward the camera in a bright kitchen setting. (2) A person's hands appear, holding a large, smooth green papaya over a white plate on a wooden cutting board. Using a metal Y-peeler, they efficiently strip away the green skin to reveal the pale flesh, then use a shredding tool to create long, thin translucent strips. (3) The pile of shredded papaya is transferred into a stainless steel mixing bowl filled with water and ice cubes to maintain crispness. In the background, a white pot sits on an induction stove. (4) A hand adds a pinch of white salt to a pot of water that is bubbling vigorously. Long green beans are then placed on the wooden board and sliced diagonally into uniform short segments using a sharp kitchen knife. (5) The beans are blanched in the boiling water, stirred with wooden chopsticks, and then removed with a wire mesh strainer to be plunged into a bowl of ice water for cooling. (6) A bright red chili is sliced into thin diagonal rounds and then finely minced with the knife. Subsequently, two garlic cloves are crushed and minced into a fine paste on the same wooden board. (7) Dried shrimp are washed in a small bowl of water and then finely chopped. A packet of seedless tamarind and a bottle of rice vinegar are shown as part of the ingredients. Tamarind pulp is mixed with hot water in a glass container. (8) Liquid ingredients including lime juice, fish sauce, and tamarind extract are combined in a glass bowl with palm sugar. The minced garlic, chili, and shrimp are added and stirred together with a wooden spoon. (9) The drained papaya strips are placed in a large metal bowl, and the dressing is poured over them. A thick wooden pestle is used to pound the mixture repeatedly, ensuring the flavors penetrate the fibers. (10) Sliced cherry tomatoes and blanched beans are added to the bowl with more dressing, followed by another round of pounding. (11) The finished salad is elegantly piled onto a white ceramic dish. A fresh lime wedge is squeezed over the salad. Finally, a woman with short dark hair in a pink apron is seen tasting the dish, smiling broadly with satisfaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 鹹香酸辣超開胃的涼拌青木瓜. [Slogan]: 夏天就是要吃涼拌菜!. (2) [Subtitle]: 青木瓜. (3) [Subtitle]: 刨皮. (4) [Subtitle]: 刨絲. (5) [Subtitle]: 泡冰水，保持脆度!. (6) [Subtitle]: 水裡加鹽. (7) [Subtitle]: 長豆斜切. (8) [Subtitle]: 汆燙1分鐘. (9) [Subtitle]: 撈起. (10) [Subtitle]: 冰水降溫 保持翠綠. (11) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾. (12) [Subtitle]: 辣椒斜切. (13) [Subtitle]: 用刀剁碎. (14) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭剁成末. (15) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭、辣椒混合. (16) [Subtitle]: 乾蝦米. (17) [Subtitle]: 清洗. (18) [Subtitle]: 剁碎.... (19) [Subtitle]: 準備醬汁.... (20) [Subtitle]: 這個是羅望子 是涼拌青木瓜的酸味來源. (21) [Subtitle]: 沒有的話，也可以改醋來增加酸味. (22) [Subtitle]: 將羅望子加到熱水裡. (23) [Subtitle]: 搓揉果肉，泡10~15分鐘. (24) [Subtitle]: 小番茄. (25) [Subtitle]: 羅望子過濾掉渣. (26) [Subtitle]: 醬汁部分：檸檬 30ml 椰糖 30克 (可用砂糖替代) 魚露 30ml 羅望子汁 30ml (可以用30ml的白醋替代). (27) [Subtitle]: 辣椒、蒜末、蝦米. (28) [Subtitle]: 攪拌. (29) [Subtitle]: 青木瓜瀝乾. (30) [Subtitle]: 先放三分之二醬汁. (31) [Subtitle]: 木棍 搗入味. (32) [Subtitle]: 敲一敲. (33) [Subtitle]: 像這樣!. (34) [Subtitle]: 小番茄、長豆. (35) [Subtitle]: 剩餘醬汁. (36) [Subtitle]: 繼續搗. (37) [Subtitle]: 敲一敲!. (38) [Subtitle]: 最後還可以加花生碎 但是我不能吃花生.... (39) [Subtitle]: 淋一點汁~. (40) [Subtitle]: 喜歡酸味明顯一點 可以再擠一點檸檬. (41) [Subtitle]: 像這樣~. (42) [Subtitle]: 那我開動囉. (43) [Subtitle]: 青木瓜好脆，好吃. (44) [Subtitle]: 好有泰式的感覺. (45) [Subtitle]: 簡單又美味!. (46) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 Youtube: @RosalinaKitchen.
